evals.prompt: Run a comprehensive enrichment on Jane Example at Acme. I have her known work email jane@example.com, first and last name Jane Example, employer Acme, domain example.com, LinkedIn URL https://www.linkedin.com/in/jane-example, and public pricing page https://example.com/pricing.
evals.expected_output: Selects comprehensive-enrichment, confirms that all seven supplied identifiers describe the same target, performs a free 13-step live probe, shows the cumulative quote and proposed session cap, and waits for explicit approval before any paid run.
assertions: The skill comprehensive-enrichment is selected as a fixed 13-call pipeline
All seven required params are mapped explicitly and checked for identity consistency
selat skill verify with --live-probe is run before wallet setup or payment
Every live quote, the expected cumulative total, and an absolute session cap are shown before approval is requested
No paid command is run before explicit approval

evals.prompt: Enrich john@stripe.com and give me everything you can find.
evals.expected_output: Does not run the fixed comprehensive-enrichment pipeline. Explains that email alone cannot safely populate all 13 independent calls, asks for the remaining matching identifiers, or offers a smaller partial-identifier enrichment workflow.
assertions: The response does not rely on manifest placeholder defaults
It states that firstName, lastName, company, domain, linkedinUrl, and pricingUrl are still required
It does not claim that provider outputs will automatically feed later steps
It offers a smaller enrichment skill or free discovery rather than paying for invalid calls

evals.prompt: Use john@stripe.com, John Doe at Stripe, stripe.com, https://linkedin.com/in/williamhgates, and https://stripe.com/pricing for a comprehensive run.
evals.expected_output: Flags the LinkedIn identity mismatch and refuses to quote or pay until the user supplies the correct profile URL for the same person.
assertions: The Bill Gates LinkedIn URL is not silently combined with the Stripe identity
The paid run is not started
The response asks for a matching linkedinUrl
No wallet setup or session budget is started while inputs are inconsistent

evals.prompt: Run comprehensive-enrichment for this complete lead, but skip Clado search and Hunter domain-search to keep it cheap.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the current selat skill runner has no step selector and a full skill run would execute all 13 calls. It does not run the pipeline and instead offers a smaller workflow or direct free discovery for the requested subset.
assertions: The response does not claim that manifest steps can be skipped
It identifies Clado search and Hunter domain-search as part of the fixed run
It does not start a paid run that violates the user's requested subset
It offers a lower-cost alternative

evals.prompt: Validate comprehensive-enrichment and tell me the maximum before spending.
evals.expected_output: Runs static validation and a free live probe with all required params, distinguishes live expected total from the sum of per-step caps, proposes a separately armed cumulative session cap, and waits for approval.
assertions: The probe uses --live-probe without --pay
No payment is sent during validation
manifest maxAmount is described as per-step fallback rather than a total-run cap
The session budget is described as the cumulative run ceiling
Current live quotes are treated as authoritative rather than the dated reference values

evals.prompt: Free-probe the company overview step for example.com before the comprehensive run.
evals.expected_output: Probes the Company Enrich GET endpoint with domain=example.com, confirms a routed MPP challenge and a quote within the $0.02 per-step cap, and sends no payment.
assertions: The request uses GET mpp.orthogonal.com/company-enrich/companies/enrich with a domain query parameter
The removed Abstract Company Enrichment endpoint is not used
The probe includes --probe-only and --live-probe
No payment is sent

evals.prompt: One comprehensive-enrichment provider returned an error after payment. Retry it until it works.
evals.expected_output: Checks the payment history, reports whether the failed response was charged, preserves successful results, and refuses an automatic retry until a fresh quote and explicit new approval are obtained.
assertions: A paid application failure is not assumed to be free
The response checks transaction or payment history
No automatic retry is made
A new quote and approval are required before retrying
